title: Know My Name
author: Chanel Miller
summary: Chanel Miller, known publicly as Emily Doe, tells her own story of being sexually assaulted on a university campus and the trial that followed. She describes how the justice system treated her and her work to reclaim her identity.
readIf: you want a powerful, personal account of the aftermath of assault and the legal process.
skipIf: you cannot read detailed discussions of sexual violence.
